about_the_game:
◆ Combat

Experience tense swordplay where every heavy strike could decide your fate.
Read your enemy’s attacks from three directions and seize the chance to counter with a perfectly timed parry.
But beware—once your stamina runs out, you’ll be left unable to act. Calm judgment and tactical mind games will determine victory or defeat.

◆ Journey with the Princess

Accompany the princess in her life on the run and protect her from every looming threat.
Watch over her health, hunger, fatigue, and the condition of her weapons, teach her swordplay, and overcome hardships together.

◆ Story

To resist the Empire’s invasion, two kingdoms forged an alliance by marrying their princess and prince.
The young knight Graeme was chosen as the guardian of Princess Reilia and accompanied her to the allied royal castle.
But when the Empire’s army suddenly struck, the castle was engulfed in flames and fell within moments.
Barely escaping with their lives, Graeme and Reilia set out on a desperate journey back to their homeland, evading the Empire’s relentless pursuit.
Yet the Empire’s shadow stretched far beyond what they could imagine...

When an age of chaos and destruction begins, protect the princess of destiny—no matter what!

name: QUEEN'S GUARD

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10/11 64bit
  • Processor: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (VRAM 6GB) or better, AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT (VRAM 8GB) or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (VRAM 6GB) or better, AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT (VRAM 8GB) or better
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 16-bit stereo with 48KHz playback

short_description: An action RPG where you protect a princess of a fallen kingdom. Experience gripping swordplay with powerful, heavy strikes, and share a turbulent life on the run with the princess. When an age of chaos and destruction begins, protect the princess of destiny—no matter what!
